summary: Completed iteration 3 regression of public APIs, auth hardening, core task flows, navigation, and responsive UI. Auth, task CRUD, comments, search, dashboard, role permissions, lockout, missing-resource 404s, and desktop/mobile flows passed; public CORS remains the only failing check.

critical.issue: Public preview ingress returns 204 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * (and wildcard methods/headers) for both the trusted preview origin and https://evil.example, despite explicit application CORS configuration and credential cookies.

action_items: Fix the public ingress/preflight layer so evil origins are rejected and trusted origins receive an explicit origin; never emit wildcard CORS with credentialed cookies.
After the ingress CORS change, rerun the security suite and browser login from the public preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: The backend middleware is explicit, but the externally observable preflight policy is different, so CORS must be audited/configured at the ingress/proxy layer as well as in FastAPI.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of exercised flows (desktop auth/task/comment/search/navigation and mobile overflow/logout)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_iteration3_ui_task and TEST_iteration3_comment through the UI; they remain because the product has no cleanup flow. Existing test data and temporary registered members also remain from prior iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use admin@northstar.team / Northstar123!. Clean pytest run passed all API assertions except evil-origin preflight. Public curl showed wildcard preflight for trusted and evil origins, while server.py and backend/.env specify explicit origins; treat this as ingress behavior until proven otherwise. Browser checks passed members, notifications, calendar/settings feedback, task comment UI, no mobile overflow, and logout. One comment assertion in the first browser script was a harness text-locator mismatch; the screenshot showed the persisted comment and the subsequent navigation script completed successfully.
rca of the issue: The public OPTIONS response is generated or rewritten upstream of the FastAPI strict_cors middleware: it returns 204, Access-Control-Allow-Origin *, wildcard headers, and broad methods for both origins. This contradicts server.py lines 160-173, which reject origins not in configured_origins and echo only the request origin. Configure/remove the ingress CORS handler and verify external OPTIONS behavior, especially because credentialed JWT cookies cannot be safely combined with wildcard origins.
